text:
jin: quick flag 3:12 UTC — validation rejects spiked on route tools.invoke-cache in sa-east after we turned on strict-shape guard. pattern: adapter sometimes returns `items:null` or `items:[]` and validator treats both as rejects in this schema. anyone watching?

theo: seeing it. small sample from logs: {error:EVAL_17, path:response.items, expected:array<object>, got:null} — looks like legacy adapters omitted the field when empty.

kiran: that adapter historically returned `[]` but a new optimization changed empty -> null to save bytes. surprise.

nina: options: 1) rollback strict-shape 2) add runtime shim to coerce null->[] 3) route to permissive variant and flag telemetry.

console-team: UX ask: when we toggle permissive fallback, console should show a clear banner per-route with active mitigation and a link to the incident. also we want an inspector showing before/after payload diffs and a small "coercion_count" stat on the route row.

ops-bot: Alert: validation.reject rate >0.7% on tools.invoke-cache (sa-east)  incident INC-8003 created.

theo: my preference is minimal hotfix: shim null->[] in the runtime for this route and emit `validation.softcoerce` telemetry. cheaper and fast.

kiran: agree. we can also add a routeOverride so if reject rate stays >0.5% for 5m we auto-switch to permissive variant. sample config: 
```
routeOverrides:\n  - route: tools.invoke-cache
    when: validation.rejects.rate > 0.005
    action: set_variant
    variant: permissive-v1
    telemetryTags: ["softcoerce","canary:10pct"]
    billingTag: billing_review
```

nina: billing: any server-side coercion has invoice implications. prefer tagging requests as `billing_review` and producing a CSV for finance. full unbillable only after manual review.

console-team: telemetry change: add metrics `validation.mode`, `coercion_count`, `reject_rate` and dimension `adapter_name`. dashboard tile will correlate `coercion_count` with `route_variant` and region.

ops-bot: Update: hotfix deployed at 03:18 UTC. runtime shim null->[] active for tools.invoke-cache in sa-east. initial drop in rejects ~60% in first 8m.

theo: rolling an automated test to CI: injections for null/empty/omitted permutations so we don't regress. will open PR.

kiran: also pushing an adapter patch to bridge-cache to restore `[]` semantics. PR #89. ETA 25m.

nina: finance: creating ticket BILL-161 for daily CSV export of requests with `billing_review=true` during mitigation windows.

console-team: added ephemeral banner: "Hotfix active: null->[] coercion for tools.invoke-cache (sa-east). Requests tagged billing_review." added inspector diff and a quick filter for `coercion_count>0`.

ops-bot: Update: reject rate down to 0.18% in the last 10m. keeping the routeOpen for 1h to validate adapter patch.

theo: long-term proposal: add validator mode `soft-coerce+provenance` that returns a sanitized payload plus `validation.provenance` array showing exact coerced paths. That way owners see what changed and we can attach per-path heuristics.

jin: +1. also document expected billing semantics for soft-coerce in the runbook. will follow up with a short RFC.

kiran: adapter patch merged and being deployed to canary now. will monitor.

nina: finance note: billing_adj policy drafted; will circulate for approval.

jin: thanks all. I'll close this thread after 60m if metrics remain stable. :thumbsup:
